name: Pasqal
description: Pasqal builds neutral-atom quantum processors for solving real-world optimization and simulation problems. Founded by pioneers of cold atom physics including Alain Aspect (Nobel laureate), Pasqal delivers quantum computing solutions to enterprise clients in energy, automotive, and finance.

products.name: Neutral-Atom QPU
products.description: Programmable neutral-atom quantum processors with up to 1,000 qubits for optimization and simulation

products.name: Pasqal Cloud
products.description: Cloud access platform for running quantum workloads on Pasqal neutral-atom hardware

highlights: Co-founded by Nobel laureate Alain Aspect, a pioneer of cold atom physics

news.title: Aramco and Pasqal make history with Saudi Arabia's first quantum computer
news.excerpt: Aramco and Pasqal launch Saudi Arabia's first Quantum Computer and Middle East's first commercial Quantum Computing as a Service platform

news.title: Quantum scale-up Pasqal plans $2B SPAC listing, promises to 'remain French'
news.excerpt: Pasqal is merging with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp II and will be listed on the Nasdaq. The merger values Pasqal at $2 billion, pre-money. Pasqal is accompanied by a separate $200 million private funding round.

news.title: Pasqal closes €340M financing in anticipation of public listing
news.excerpt: €170M private round plus €170M convertible financing from Parkway, Quanta Computer, LG Electronics and CMA CGM ahead of dual Nasdaq and Euronext listing.

news.title: Pasqal announces intention to go public in $2B SPAC deal
news.excerpt: Merger with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II values Pasqal at about $2 billion and could bring $600M+ in total proceeds.

news.title: Pasqal Thoughts 2026 event marks quantum computing's shift from research to real-world deployment
news.excerpt: More than 150 participants from 10+ countries gathered in Paris to discuss industry use cases in finance, energy, and telecom, and Pasqal's path toward 1,000-qubit systems and HPC integration.

news.title: Pasqal and Crédit Agricole CIB Advance Strategic Partnership for Quantum in Capital Markets
news.excerpt: Crédit Agricole CIB and Pasqal formalized an advanced strategic partnership to accelerate quantum computing deployment in capital markets, with initial production use cases targeted for 2028, focusing on risk analytics and portfolio optimization.

news.title: Pasqal and MegazoneCloud Sign MoU to Deploy Neutral-Atom Quantum Computing in South Korea
news.excerpt: Pasqal and MegazoneCloud (South Korea's largest AWS partner) signed an MoU to explore QPU integration into managed cloud services and pursue on-premises QPU deployments at Korean enterprise and HPC customers across finance, logistics, biotech, and manufacturing.

news.title: Pasqal Leads Launch of €50M Q-PLANET EU Pilot Line to Industrialize Neutral-Atom Quantum Chips
news.excerpt: Q-PLANET, coordinated by Pasqal and co-funded by the EU Chips Joint Undertaking, kicked off with 28 European partners across 11 member states. The six-year €50M Framework Partnership Agreement aims to advance neutral-atom chip components from TRL 4 to TRL 6.
